originalReleaseNotification: IndexNow only; this follow-up completed Google and Bing sitemap notifications.

google.temporaryFailure: Homeoffice first showed a generic sitemap HTTP error; the first individual-URL live test reported Robots.txt unreachable. Robots recrawl was requested; Google subsequently read the sitemap successfully and discovered252URLs.
google.individualUrlRequestLimit: The subsequent individual URL request failed when the Google reCAPTCHA service could not be reached. No CAPTCHA was solved and no claim of a queued individual indexing request is made.

interpretation: Submission acceptance and successful sitemap retrieval do not establish page indexing or rankings.
